teaser: What happens when a life built around care meets a temperament built to run things? Life path 6 asks for responsibility toward home and the people in it; ESTJ supplies the discipline to carry it out without flinching. The two make a household someone could set a watch by — meals on time, problems met head-on, no one wondering who's in charge of dinner. What doesn't come as naturally is turning that same attention inward, toward whether the one running things gets cared for too.
excerpt: Three cups of coffee, refilled without being asked, in a diner booth empty but for the two of you at closing — that's where a six lets its guard down, in gestures rather than declarations.
